name: What Happens to the Goal?
summary: Traces goal information inside policies exhibiting goal misgeneralization and reports that the depth at which the goal is lost predicts which recovery method succeeds.
numbers: 8 navigation and manipulation tasks; steering 16.0%→95.3%; new wiring 31.6%→84.3%

why.xr: Competent pursuit of the wrong goal, measured with no catastrophic scenario.
